verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the subhead is blown up until it nearly matches the headline, while the CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill sitting off-centre (left of the axis) far below a big dead gap, so the action is buried. B keeps the centred stack, sizes and CTA prominence of the original, but it is just a vertically spaced-out copy: the gaps between the headline, the small subhead and the button are uneven and too large, so the three pieces read as separate fragments and the upper third is empty.
